result.summary: Вердикт PASS: четвёртый проход по моим собственным запускам на свежих копиях метки не нашёл ни одного блокирующего недочёта. Замечание V1 снято: отбрасывание закрывающих скобок в конце значения теперь написано одним проходом, на 4 МиБ знаков «)» после «token=» оно занимает 83 мс (естественная запись через поиск пары — 4,3 с на 512 КиБ и растёт вчетверо на каждое удвоение), а новое двенадцатое семейство прибора убивает такую запись; все 106 образцов «хранится» и 108 образцов «отказ» сходятся без одной ошибки, ровно двенадцать старых тестов краснеют, остальные 536 зелёные. Остались только мелкие недочёты текста (устаревшие ссылки на решение 0102 после ответов владельца, неверная фраза про «ни одной ключеподобной строки» в разделе 18, один вариант мутанта м43 убивается слишком долго) — они не мешают сборке.

findings.pass_item: pass A item 3 (mutants of the design), criterion 10 / m43
findings.place: design section 11 row m43 ('an indexOf on the rest, or a recount'), section 10 family 12, fact F33
findings.what: Family 12 kills m43 in its indexOf form (my run: ratio 15.76 at 1 MiB, ts 1089.9 / 17181 ms, k = 1, the killing run 166.6 s), and the eleven earlier families do not see it (worst ratio 4.21 under m43). The recount form named in the same row is not killed in a practical time: one call costs 1002 ms on 32 KiB, 3996 ms on 64 KiB, 16053 ms on 128 KiB (x4 per doubling), i.e. about 64 s on 256 KiB and about 1000 s on 1 MiB; the instrument makes 11 calls on 256 KiB (2 outcome calls, 1 warm-up, the choice of k, 7 repeats), about 12 minutes before the first comparison, and the comparison itself needs ten calls of about 1000 s. The test would go red only by a time-out. A general property of every mutant that is quadratic with a big constant (my explicit-loop m5 on family 1 also cost 290 s, ratio 16.21), but the row promises the recount form.
findings.needed: Say in the row that m43 is applied in the indexOf form (the recount form is only a longer way to the same red), or give family 12 smaller sizes like family 11 so that both forms go red in minutes.

findings.what: The sentence is false. My search over the file ('sk_live_' followed by 10 characters, 'ya29.', a three-part JWT of the 'eyJ' shape, the PEM header lines) finds the Stripe-shaped string of C13 (24 characters after 'sk_live_'), the Google-shaped 'ya29.' string, the JWT of C6/C21 (fake payload) and the PEM header lines. findings.pass_item: pass A item 3 (own mutants), pass C item 8
findings.place: design section 2.2 item 3 (the counting reading of the closer drop) and section 11 (accepted survivors)
findings.what: The text fixes the counting reading ('more closers of its kind than openers'). The presence reading (a closer is dropped only when the value has no opener of its kind, three flags, also one pass) passes the whole oracle (106 kept, 108 refused, no wrong form, same as counting and as the indexOf reading) and every planned test, but it decides differently on strings such as 'token=${A}}' and 'token=${{A}}}': counting keeps them, presence refuses them. Direction measured on 300 000 random strings: presence keeps more on 0, refuses more on 0 (no random string in my pool hit the difference); by construction presence drops a subset of what counting drops, so it can only refuse more. The design names the three readings in F33 but lists no survivor or pair for this one, so a developer who writes the simpler presence reading is not stopped by a test and gets a few more false refusals.
findings.needed: List the presence reading in section 11 as an accepted survivor (it refuses more, the safe direction of Q7), or add a pair for the counting rule (a kept 'token=${A}}').
